PRADEEPKUMAR J S

Product manager

Email: pradeepkumar.js@gmail.com

Contact. No: 7892615589

I am a Certified banker, financial services professional with 15+years of Investment Banking experience as solution designer for Treasury products. encompassing knowledge of FX Operations, Mutual Fund Operations, Money Market, Customer Service, Treasury or Cash management, Business Development and Personnel Relations skills.

Specializing in Manual and Automation testing, Highly Experienced in Banking BFSI domain, Treasury and Capital Markets, Retail and Digital Banking Testing.

Banking Operations SQL Query Writing Business Analyst

Functional Consulting Team Management

❖ Core Banking applications- Hand’s on Experience

➢ Oracle- Flex cube

➢ T24 Transact – R18

➢ FXPCA, TLM, MCH, FXALL, GTSS, MYSIS,

➢ Bloomberg, Reuters, Swift Alliance (STARS)

❖ Application Life Cycle Management

➢ Jira & Confluence

MAVERIC SYSTEMS LIMITED - March 2024 – October 2025

Designation: Project/Product Manager

Bangalore, Karnataka.

Gathered and analyzed business requirements to identify data sources and reporting needs. • Created data visualizations to communicate insights to stakeholders. • Partnered with stakeholders to balance competing priorities and ensure optimal value delivery. • Collaborated with cross-functional teams to refine user stories, define acceptance criteria, and maintain a clear backlog.

Developed test plans and test cases related to change requests (CRs). •

Implement QA standards, best practices, and test process frameworks (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, V-Model). Introduce and drive improvements in test automation, tooling, and workflows.

Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for defects and ensure quality gates are met.

Client Project 1: Trusted Novus Bank (TNB) – April 2024-Sep 2024.

Results-driven functional consultant and subject matter expert (SME) involved in product certifications. • Identified business and functional requirements by collaborating with application end-users and led the collection, analysis, documentation, and coordination of those requirements. Served as the primary point of contact for clients, effectively addressing and solving functional issues.

• Provided functional insights into high-level business requirements. •

Involvement in analysis & investigation of Production defects and Testing issues raised during project life cycle.

Managed system testing and validation to ensure compliance with business requirements. • • Supported the development of training materials and conducted training sessions. I gained experience in writing Business Requirement Documents, Scope of Work, Daily Status Reports, Weekly Status Reports, Test Strategy, and Test Design.

Managed a team of business users, providing functional support to enhance their efficiency. • Engaged with clients and internal stakeholders to review test designs and ensure their approval.

Client Project 2: Arab National Bank (ANB) – October 2024-March 2025.

Assisted in the development and implementation of organizational strategies, policies, and procedures. • Gathered requirements and prepared business documents for the current functional upgrade. • Demonstrated expertise in writing Business Requirement Documents, Scope of Work, Daily Status Reports, Weekly Status Reports, Test Strategies, and Test Designs.

Efficiently managed teams and stakeholders to negotiate and balance demands and expectations. • Assisted the team in raising functionality defects in JIRA and effectively managed defect triage calls to discuss bugs raised by the team.

Managed walkthrough sessions for business users regarding the collection application. • Prepared detailed test plans and executed projects according to the plan. • Guided the test team during SIT support and provided functional assistance to define the regression test scope.

Assisted in translating the functional design into a technical design by explaining functionalities to developers.

Possessed hands-on experience in writing SQL queries. • • Analyzed issues logged by the client and provided solutions within the agreed turnaround time (TAT). • Executed releases and rollouts during the tenure.

Identified gaps and suggested transformations in the bank’s processes and procedures.

Client Project 3: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank (ADCB) – March 2024- Present.

Analyzing the requirements and mapping them to the current functionalities of the system. • Prepare and review the training material for client training. • Assisting in the initial parameter set up for the client. • Testing Real time scenarios in terms of functional part to identify the gaps that need to be developed. • Preparing the detail Test Plan and executing the project as per plan. • Guided test team for SIT support and provided functional support to define regression test scope. • Assist in cascading the functional design into technical design by explaining functionality internally to the developers.

Oversee defect lifecycle: logging, prioritization, triage, fix verification, and closure. • Prepared and executed test cases based on FRD/BRD, conducted validation testing, and raised defects in Jira.

Collaborated with developers for quick issue resolution and reported status to clients. • Prepare daily/weekly test status reports, dashboards, and quality metrics. • Maintain documentation: test strategy, test summary reports, risk logs, and compliance records. • Liaise with business teams to plan and support User Acceptance Testing.

INVESTMENT BANKING SECTOR – EXPERIENCE 13YRS

JP MORGAN CHASE BANK – SEP 2022-AUG 2023

Worked on Digital banking across all modules end-to-end operations for Retail Banking.

Responsibilities:

Managed end-to-end digital transaction processing, reconciling 500+ daily transactions with >99.8% accuracy. • Develop and drive the digital transformation strategy for retail banking products (savings, current accounts, loans, cards, payments, wealth).

Developed operational workflows for mobile and web platforms, reducing processing inefficiencies by 20%. • Led cross-functional coordination between operations, IT, and compliance for system rollouts, improving migration timelines.

Treasury operations specialist for timely and accurate settlement of JP Morgans settlement obligations • • Ensured compliance with banking regulations (KYC/AML, PCI-DSS), implementing control frameworks for all digital workflows.

Fulfil payments daily to 3rd parties, as needed.

Daily review of the settlement files received from the agents against the firms’ books and records to substantiate the amounts against the agreed calculation mechanics and issue settlement instructions. Identified operational bottlenecks, introducing automation that cut manual work

• Conducted daily compliance checks and internal audits, ensuring a zero major audit issues record.

STATE STREET HCL SERVICES PVT LTD – JAN 2018-SEP 2022

Part of Transition Team, migrated to a new process to State Street HCL Pvt ltd (Cash COE Mutual Fund Operations)

Responsibilities:

Responsible for 18 people and process Management • Cash sweep (Daily, Custody DDA recon, Cash sweep, FED wire setup approval, cash memo/Capstock posting approval, Trade settlements for mutual funds.

Responsible for working on fixed income securities, Equities on cash reconciliation daily. • Assess the current-state mutual fund processes (trade processing, settlements, reconciliations, corporate actions, reporting).

Conduct detailed process walkthroughs, SOP reviews, system mapping, and control evaluation with the outgoing team/vendor.

Document current workflows, exception scenarios, risk points, and upstream/downstream interfaces. • Capture technology architecture (e.g., Geneva, Aladdin, Charles River, TLM, in-house fund accounting systems).

Responsible for understanding the critical path and critical chain in process and allocating the resources. • Handle a bandwidth of products (Equities, Mutual Funds, Insurance Funds, Fixed Income securities, Collateral securities, Security Lending) etc.

Organizing the PDPs, cross trainings, BAU, monthly, and weekly schedules for the teammates. • Part of process initiations, improvements and system automations which had resulted in smooth flow of process, increase in STP rate, utilization of resources on the required areas.

Build detailed KT plans, training modules, and process handover documentation.



Lead knowledge transfer sessions, shadowing, reverse shadowing, and supervised BAU runs.

Track KT progress, evaluate readiness, and certify teams for independent BAU handling.

DEUTSCHE BANK OPERATIONS INTERNATIONAL (DBOI) – May 2008-2016

From the beginning of my career, I have been part of FX MM and Derivatives operations. Hence clubbed the areas of expertise in complete BO operations which include Confirmations, Settlements, Post- Settlements, Claims & Reconciliation. Responsibilities:

Provide SME support and are responsible for the smooth functioning of Derivatives & Foreign exchange BO &MO operations for all the regions.

Responsible for day-to-day operations in Deliveries within Derivatives business-The scope includes Futures & Option contracts processing across exchange & regions which includes managing most sensitive activities like Exercise, Assignment, Position Management & Expiry Processing.

Processing daily Foreign Exchange Cash and Commodities Trades, Confirmations, Netting and Settlements for Interbank / Corporate clients.

Confirmation and Documentation of NDF Long forms and paper confirmations for sensitive corporate clients. And verifying agreement maintained with counterparts.

Migrated and lead NA Clearing team from London and ensuring all NA Fixed Income / Equity Contracts executed in NA Markets (CME, CBOT, NYBOT (ICEUS), COMEX, NYMEX) should be cleared to respective client accounts.

Ensure all the trade (both Gross and Netting Settlements) are settled on or before the Funding or Nostro Cutoffs as applicable and monitor Cash Management queries and inform them of any unprocessed funding trades and contact the clients regarding the non-receipts and inform the cash management.

Process clearing & settlement activity for derivatives trades executed in US & Japan on behalf of Japanese, Korean and Hong Kong portfolios. Products include.

Review, execute, and oversee daily margin activity for bilateral OTC, cleared OTC, Exchanged Traded Derivatives, and Repo/Reverse Repos

Sound knowledge of investment banking products including Swaps, Bonds and Interest Rate Futures ● Affirmation and execution of ISDA trade confirmation i.e. paper and electronically confirmed. ● Management of SWIFT transactions related to confirmations and settlements instruction by using MT 300,103, 202, 299, 199, 305, 306, 292, 399, 600, 601 etc.

Closely monitoring the account balances on a live basis through Nostro agent’s systems (if any). If not exchanging emails with Nostro agent contacts as and when required till the cut-offs.

Monitoring queries from the agent Banks and informing to the respective settlements team on any unprocessed payments, contacting the clients in regards to the non-receipts and informing the Treasury dealers.

Reconciliation of Statement and Ledger entries and identifying the breaks like Non receipt or Nonpayment of Funds and sending an alert to the necessary teams to follow-up accordingly.

Sweeping the Funds from one account to other account based on the requests from the treasury dealers in order to Fund and balance the accounts.

Preparing a Day-to-Day report - EOD by using Excel and outlook and sending them across the regional heads in



order to maintain the record of our efforts and for the audit purpose. Investigating failed payments, recalling funds paid to client in error, amendment of wrong payments, checking regarding receipts & payments.

AWARDS & RECOGNITIONS:

Procured NCFM Certification in Capital market and Derivatives. • Business engineering award for the Interest allocation project • Worked on the project which has saved the bank nearly $ 4500/per month on Reuters access. • Certification on MIS reporting & Business Modeling using MS-Excel issued by Excel goodies • Accolades’ mail from the stakeholder for enhanced coverage on functional unearthing many blind points in development of application.

EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

Master of Business Administration in Finance from RIIMS College Affiliated to Sri Venkateswara University,

Tirupathi. (Pass out year 2005-2007).

PERSONAL INFORMATION:

Gender: Male Nationality: Indian Date of Birth: 09/08/1983 Father name: K.J. Shiva Kumar Marital Status: Married. Language Known: English, Hindi, Telugu & Kannada Passport No: C3299997 Expiry date: 27.10.2034

Best regards, Pradeepkumar JS.
